EXECUCOES = [{"quem": "ana", "rodou": True}, {"quem": "bruno", "rodou": False}]


def adocao(registros):
    total = len(registros)
    usaram = sum(1 for r in registros if r["rodou"])
    return f"{usaram}/{total} com uso observado"


print(adocao(EXECUCOES))
